Van Heron Labs reads your cells at multi-omic depth, builds a comprehensive biological digital twin, and translates their physiology into decisions — media, feed, process, and manufacturing outcomes. Then our team delivers what those insights recommend, from analytics through commercial scale. See the platform → Work with us What we do What we do We turn cellular biology into commercial outcomes. Every engagement starts with reading your cells and ends with a delivered improvement to your process, product, or program. Not analytics for its own sake — decisions and materials you can put to work. 01 Process development Mechanism-backed process modifications and feed strategies that improve titer, viability, and CQAs. 02 Novel chemically-defined media Full formulations designed from cellular data, with complete ingredient transparency and IP flexibility. 03 Novel supplements & feeds Targeted CD supplements and specific-biologic feed strategies designed for your cell system and process or as new products you can sell commercially. 04 Deep physiological profiling Multi-omic characterization of cells, cultures, and ancillary materials — the highest-resolution picture available. 05 Comparative studies Head-to-head evaluations across cell types, processes, or reagent prototypes — with mechanism, not just outcome. 06 Scale-up transitions De-risked bench-to-clinic and clinic-to-commercial transitions grounded in what the cells actually need at scale. 07 Cytokine & growth factor profiling Precision profiling and design of signaling environments for cell therapy, regenerative medicine, and complex mammalian programs. 08 Manufacturability rescue Root-cause diagnosis and process fixes for programs stuck on titer plateaus, CQA drift, or lot-to-lot variability. 09 Modulator & biomarker discovery Existing small-molecule modulators of your cells' actual biology — plus novel biomarker candidates for CQAs, QC panels, and process control. Discovery, not synthesis. IP in the identification and combination, not in new chemistry to qualify. 10 Novel process architecture Bioprocess designs — fed-batch strategies, timing, temperature/pH staging, feed regimens — built from your cells' actual biology. IP transfers to you. Same regulatory profile as any process design decision, not a novel chemical entity. 11 Ancillary materials characterization Multi-omic profiling of your raw materials — serum lots, growth factors, ancillary reagents. Understand batch-to-batch variability at the molecular level. Backs lot qualification, process robustness, and supplier selection. 12 Program discovery & feasibility studies Rapid characterization on new cell systems, novel modalities, or exploratory samples — including from public data. Turn "we're not sure this will work" into "here's the mechanism, and here's what to try next." What makes us different Not a culture media manufacturer. Not a software tool. Something new. Six ways VHL is different from every other player in this space. Each one is a category we defined or a model we brought here. 01 — The platform Cellular, not process. Where other digital twins model the bioreactor — and other platforms generate new molecules to add to it — ours models the biology inside your cells . Biology-first, not molecule-first. The only commercially available multi-omic cellular digital twin. 02 — Prediction Across biology and manufacturing. Most bioprocess models predict batch behavior from sensor data. Ours predict biological outcomes — manufacturability, potency, therapeutic quality — from the cells themselves. Category-defining platform capability. 03 — The team Expert scientists on your program. 70+ years of combined experience in bioprocessing, PD, media, reagents, and chemically-defined systems. Alumni of Eli Lilly, Roche, Sanofi, Merck KGaA, Thermo Fisher, Cytiva, and MIT. You work with them directly. 04 — IP model Novel IP. Safe chemistry. Novel formulations, feeds, and process architectures — designed from your biology — become IP advantages . All using characterized components in novel combinations. Real defensible IP without new-chemistry qualification burden. Full ingredient transparency and custom commercial pathways. Not the black-box model. 05 — Delivery End-to-end from cells to scale. You bring the cells. We handle everything else — from multi-omic characterization through clinic-ready and commercial-scale delivery . Analytics to clinic. Analytics to commercial. One co-development engagement. 06 — Business model Not any single thing on the market. Not a media manufacturer. Not a software tool. Not a CDMO. Not a testing service. Not a shop designing new molecules for you to qualify. A biology-first cellular intelligence engine that surfaces what your cells actually need — and delivers what none of those categories alone can. Problems we solve For teams pushing the limits of what cells can do. Three audiences. Three sets of questions we're built to answer. Bioprocessing & Biologics "Are you leaving yield on the table and not even realizing?" For CHO mAb, biosimilar, biobetter, viral vector, and vaccine programs stuck on titer plateaus, CQA drift, or manufacturability issues that DoE can't crack. We surface the mechanism, deliver the fix, and hold it at scale. Cell & Gene Therapy "Understanding cell therapies is life or death. Do you know what drives differentiation, potency, persistence — and the difference between a cell that cures and a cell that quits? " For autologous, allogeneic, and regenerative programs where cellular state defines therapeutic outcome. We characterize what makes cells work — and design the media, feeds, and processes that keep them working through manufacturing and into the patient. Microbial & Fermentation "Did you know E. coli can double in just 5 minutes? Do you understand what trace elements, cofactors, macronutrients, and signaling molecules your cultures need to reach their biological maxima?" For E. coli, yeast, and industrial microbial programs where nutrient depletion and metabolic bottlenecks determine yield. We identify what your culture is asking for at every timepoint — and design the feed that answers. Delivered results Numbers from programs we've already shipped. 200-400% Higher titer 45-900% Greater cell density 30-70% Faster processes 100% Chemically defined Ranges reflect delivered outcomes across CHO, HEK, E. coli, Mv1Lu, and MSC programs. Every engagement is scoped and priced independently. No partnership commitment, no minimum volume, no exclusivity. Choose the depth that fits your program today — expand only when a specific opportunity warrants it. "Are you reading our minds? This is exactly what we need." — VHL Customer The four levels Four levels of depth. Each adds capability. Each stands alone. Level 01 and 02 are the natural entry points. Level 03 and 04 exist for programs that want to go deeper — separate conversations when a specific program warrants it. Level 01 Insights Analysis, results, recommendations. Analyze your data, deliver full cell profiles, and produce targeted recommendations to improve your system. You oversee and execute any implementation. The right entry point when you have strong internal capability and want fast, mechanism-backed intelligence to inform your team's decisions. Best for Teams with larger R&D, process, and product development teams who just need information — delivered fast, backed by mechanism. Level 02 Insights + Process Development Recommendations → specifications + support through scaling. Level 01, plus specific R&D, chemistry, and process recommendations linked directly to functional improvements or technical milestones — for example, target improvements in titer, novel biomarkers, or CQA stability. Recommendations become specifications — with support through scaling and toward commercial deployment. Best for Teams with in-house capabilities who need targeted support to accomplish specific technical and commercial goals. Level 03 Full Development Media, feed, reagent, and ancillary materials — formulation, testing, scale. Level 02, plus we handle testing and validation of full formulations using high-throughput approaches and scaled bioreactor runs where appropriate. Media, feed, reagent, and ancillary materials formulation, testing, and scale-up — under one engagement. Best for Engagements where processes require additional formulation, development, and validation — beyond what internal teams can execute on their own. Level 04 Full Stack You bring the cells. We handle everything else. Level 03, plus scaled production coordination to commercial endpoints for your program. cGMP, clinic-ready, and scaled results. We handle the entire value chain — from cellular intelligence through to commercial-ready program. Best for Teams that want end-to-end results. You bring the cells and the strategic direction — we handle everything downstream. Commercial structures Every company has unique problems — and a unique budget. Commercial structures are flexible. Every engagement is scoped to your program, priorities, and economics — usually comprising one or :. Structure 01 Flat fees Fixed pricing based on engagement phases and defined KPIs. Predictable cost and timeline — the most common structure for scoped pilots and Level 01–02 engagements. Structure 02 Milestones / success Payments tied to phase completion and technical milestone achievement. Balances predictable structure with shared alignment on outcomes — common in Level 03 co-development engagements. Structure 03 Backends Structures based on KPIs and commercial endpoints — allowing more of the value to be captured at outcome rather than upfront. A good fit for teams with smaller near-term budgets and clear commercial goals. Specialist economics You pay for cellular intelligence and measurable outcomes — not brand premium or overhead. Instead of layered service tiers and enterprise vendor pricing, you get more comprehensive and higher-quality deliverables. Complete R&D, process, and product development under one engagement — at total commercial obligations meaningfully below comparable partnerships. Partner network Strategic partners powering what we deliver. Cellular intelligence at commercial scale isn't a solo effort. VHL's platform is delivered in partnership with a curated network — from sequencing to formulation to manufacturing — chosen because they're the best at what they do. Sequencing Coordinated multi-omic sequencing for every engagement where VHL runs analytics from samples. Rapid turnaround, cost-effective per-sample economics, quality data ready for the platform pipeline. Bioprocess optimization High throughput bioreactor infrastructure for testing recommended process conditions for new feed strategies, and media formulations. Rapid turn-around between platform recommendation and bioreactor validation. High-throughput screening & test batches High-throughput ingredient screening and performance validation. Prototype batch production for formulation candidates. Media manufacturing at scale Contract media manufacturing from pilot through commercial scales for novel formulations designed by the VHL platform. GMP-capable, ingredient-transparent, fully scalable, ready for programs headed to clinic or commercial. Custom media manufacturing Custom media manufacturing with cost-optimized economics. When programs need custom formulations at scale without enterprise vendor pricing. Chemically-defined microbial media Chemically-defined media CMO specifically engineered for microbial systems. Purpose-built for the entire range of eukaryotic and prokaryotic microbial programs for solid and liquid media. cGMP manufacturing & CDMO network Strategic partnerships with cGMP-capable CDMOs across mammalian bioprocessing and cell therapy — spanning Europe, APAC, and the US. For engagements looking to hand off production. Every engagement is scoped to leverage the right partners for your specific program, needs, and budget. Intellectual property A new level of IP flexibility. We're one of the few companies that provides ingredient transparency and flexible IP structures for novel formulations we produce. Process, product, media, and manufacturing improvements we deliver become new IP assets for your company. Ingredient transparency You see the formulation. Every component, every source, every rationale — documented and delivered. No black box between you and your process. Flexible IP pathways Make new IP your new commercial asset. Novel formulations we produce for you come with many options — structured per engagement. Your improvements, new assets Your process is just as important as your product. Process, product, media, and manufacturing improvements we deliver become new IP estate for your company which can increase your enterprise value Actual terms are mapped per engagement based on your specific commercial structure. Platform — Van Heron Labs Van Heron Labs Platform Customers Engagement Company Get in touch The Platform Cellular intelligence platform for biotech and bioprocessing. Our platform reads your cells at multi-omic depth , models them as a comprehensive biological digital twin, translates complex physiology to answers, and predicts outcomes before you commit. Our team translates outputs to commercial outcomes. Multi-nodal. One system. Built for teams pushing the limits of what cells can do. Platform architecture Layers that read, model, and predict what your cells actually need. Each layer stands alone — together, they close the loop between your cells and your process decisions. Turning omics data into better processes, media formulations, feed strategies, and manufacturing and therapeutic quality predictions. Biology-first, not molecule-first. We characterize what your cells are actually doing — and surface the media, feeds, existing modulators, and biomarkers that address it. No new chemistry to qualify. No new raw materials to clear. Real biology, existing components, faster path to production. Layer 01 The read layer. Deep cell characterization. Multi-omic profiling — Omics deconvolved into what your cells are actually doing. The most comprehensive molecular weight range of small and large molecule needs, expression, full metabolic profiles, lineage mapping and projection, and more funneled to function, cell status, stress diagnosis. Months of bench work in days. Inputs: RNA-seq (your data or VHL-coordinated), plus any proteomics, metabolomics, spent media, process data you have/want Outputs: deep cell profile, biomarker candidates for CQAs and QC panels, existing-molecule modulator candidates targeting real biological pathways in your cells, metabolic bottleneck identification, comparability analysis, and much more Best for: characterization studies, comparability studies, root-cause diagnosis, program discovery Layer 02 The model layer. Biological digital twin. Your cells and cultures unified into an comprehensive biological digital model. Understand your process without a team, months of work, or massive spend. The best complement to in-line analytics available. Category-defining Where other digital twins model the bioreactor, ours models the biology inside it. The only commercially available multi-omic cellular digital twin. What it is: a live, interrogable model of your specific cell system built from your data What it enables: hypothesis testing, condition comparison, mechanism inspection, decision support Ownership: the twin is yours for the duration of the engagement and beyond Programs delivered with Layer 02 Digital twins built for MSCs, iPSCs, ESCs and bioprocessing programs. Average 2 weeks to build. Layer 03 The translate layer. Agentic layer. Ask anything — your digital twin answers directly, backed by mechanism from your data (not the literature, unless you want it). Simulate scenarios, test hypotheses, compare conditions before you commit resources. Ask: "why is titer plateauing after day 8?" — get a mechanism-level answer Ask: "what's driving glycoform drift in this lot?" — get the specific pathway conditions Ask: "what would happen if I doubled Fe and halved glucose?" — get a predicted outcome with rationale Layer 04 The predict layer. Prediction modules. Predict manufacturing, and even therapeutic, success from starting, donor, upstream data. Predict product quality from cell profile. Identify biomarkers for KQAs and regulatory submission. Prediction that spans biology and manufacturing with the ultimate goal of delivering patient outcomes — not just process. Category-defining claim Most bioprocess models predict batch behavior from sensor data. Ours predict biological outcomes — manufacturability, potency, therapeutic quality — from the cells themselves. Manufacturing prediction: which starting material lots will produce robust batches; which won't Product quality prediction: glycoform, PTM, and aggregation outcomes from cell profile Therapeutic prediction: potency, persistence, and functional attributes for cell therapy programs Regulatory support: biomarker identification for KQA panels + comparability + release testing Layer 05 The human layer. The scientific team. The VHL scientific team translates platform outputs into optimized manufacturing processes, media, feed, and reagent formulations. Discovery to cGMP-scaled, clinic-compatible programs — R&D, process, and product development under one engagement. Cell therapy · Immuno-oncology "How do we get more out of T cell and Treg expansion for immuno-oncology and autoimmune programs?" Public dataset study · Presented at ISCT 2025 The approach. Multi-omic characterization of published T cell and Treg expansion protocols. VHL identified stress response signatures in standard media and mapped ~50 key nutrients expected to improve viability and expansion. What we found Eight novel small-molecule FOXP3 regulators identified in silico. Novel growth factors flagged as targets — with mechanism-level rationale for each. Results 80% Survival + proliferation T cell manufacturing ~50 Key nutrients identified Mechanism-backed <24h Data to insight In-silico turnaround Mammalian bioprocessing · biologics "How do we develop a novel chemically defined media formulation for HEK cells that retains titer and quality as well as our current expensive proprietary formula?" Biologics developer · Vaccine production The approach. Multi-omic characterization of the cell line in production conditions. VHL identified specific metabolic bottlenecks limiting productivity and delivered a fully chemically defined HEK basal media formulation — designed to be transparent, cheaper, and hold critical quality attributes stable. What we found Novel macro and mucronutrient needs of the cells. New ingredients plus fomrula chemistry intelligence delivered as validated formulation. Results 95% Comparable with original formulation Mammalian processing Mechanism CQA defensibility Comparability 1 Engagement R&D through validation Microbial production · Recombinant protein "How do we push recombinant protein titer for a therapeutic application?" E. coli · Recombinant collagen for wound healing The approach. Multi-omic profiling of the E. coli production strain in traditional LB culture media. VHL delivered a custom media supplement of 22 new and additional ingredients — mechanism-backed redesign, not empirical screening. What we found The recombinant protein yield ceiling was governed by complex amino acid and and cofactor limitations, not by expression system capacity. The reformulated media pushed titer nearly 4X at equivalent cell density. Methodology generalizes across bacterial systems. Results 4X Recombinant titer 365% increase 22 New ingredients Custom supplement 1X Cell density Same, higher yield Multiple culture cnditions "How do we deliver our customers meaningful growth and expression gains — for cell types where the literature runs thin?" Multi cell-type optimization The approach. Deep characterization across multiple cell type systems — pushing platform generality beyond well-characterized model systems. VHL identified species-specific metabolic and cofactor needs across each cell type, delivering targeted supplement designs. What we found Growth and expression gains ranged from 250% to 900% across the tested cell types. The same methodology generalized across species — reinforcing that cellular intelligence is not a per-cell-type engineering effort but a universal platform capability.
